notes: Overall aim is solid, capable of securing quick eliminations.
Recoil control is generally good, allowing for consistent shots at range.
Target acquisition is quick, especially in close-quarters engagements.
Could benefit from more consistent headshot aiming to reduce time-to-kill.
Movement is often too aggressive, leading to overexposure in open areas.
More disciplined use of cover and power sliding would improve survivability.
Reloading in the open frequently negates good movement into advantageous positions.
Good use of jump shots in some engagements to throw off enemy aim.

coachingSummary:
Your profile in this VOD: Aim 7.7/10, Positioning 4.1/10, Decision-Making 4.4/10.
What you are doing well: you can win clean gunfights; clean opening pick.
What is costing you SR right now: overheat after blood; positioning under pressure; fight decisions after contact.
Stop doing this immediately: overheat after blood.
Do this instead every fight: After winning a fight, move to hard cover before you search for the next engagement.
Next 5 ranked maps plan:
1) Overheat After Blood: Cue word: KCC. Repeat in 10 ranked fights: no second peek until cover touch. Target: Cut this habit by 50% over the next 5 ranked maps.
2) Untradeable Wide Exposure: In your next 3 maps, call out your cover before each chall: left/right hard cover only. Target: Cut this habit by 50% over the next 5 ranked maps.
3) Inconsistent Conversion Discipline: 15-minute private match block: pre-aim lanes, no sprint into LOS, track conversion percentage. Target: Cut this habit by 30% over the next 5 ranked maps.
Success condition: fewer isolated deaths, fewer panic re-challs, and better life value after each first blood.

srLeakingHabits.name: Overheat After Blood
srLeakingHabits.trigger: After first contact or a pick, immediate re-chall without cover reset.
srLeakingHabits.replacement: Kill -> Cover -> Clear next threat lane before re-peeking.
srLeakingHabits.drill: Cue word: KCC. Repeat in 10 ranked fights: no second peek until cover touch.

srLeakingHabits.name: Untradeable Wide Exposure
srLeakingHabits.trigger: Taking gunfights while open to multiple angles with weak teammate trade access.
srLeakingHabits.replacement: Slice one angle at a time and anchor to cover before committing damage.
srLeakingHabits.drill: In your next 3 maps, call out your cover before each chall: left/right hard cover only.

srLeakingHabits.name: Inconsistent Conversion Discipline
srLeakingHabits.trigger: First bullets land, but follow-up movement/finishing sequence is unstable.
srLeakingHabits.replacement: Prioritize first bullet accuracy plus damage conversion over flashy movement.
srLeakingHabits.drill: 15-minute private match block: pre-aim lanes, no sprint into LOS, track conversion percentage.
